extracted.intended_audience: music fans who want to livestream Rolling Loud 2026 online (viewers seeking free/streaming access)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step guidance for accessing and watching the Rolling Loud 2026 music festival livestream — including required platforms/subscriptions, dates/times, and per-day lineups. Focused on how to watch the event (including using a free trial).

rubrics_metrics.name: Required subscription to Amazon Music or Prime Video
rubrics_metrics.description: To livestream Rolling Loud, you’ll need a subscription to Amazon Music or Prime Video.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article repeatedly states Amazon Music or Prime Video is the platform required to access the livestream; it emphasizes that these services will give fans access even if they aren’t in Central Florida.

rubrics_metrics.name: Free trial option for non-members (30-day)
rubrics_metrics.description: Not a member? Sign up for a 30-day free trial to take advantage of all that Amazon Prime has to offer, including access to Rolling Loud.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page recommends new users sign up for Amazon Prime's 30-day free trial to watch for free and lists other Prime benefits (Prime Gaming, Prime Reading, Amazon Photos, fast free shipping, in-store discounts at Whole Foods, access to Prime Day/Black Friday events) as additional incentives for trial sign-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival dates and start time
rubrics_metrics.description: Rolling Loud runs Friday, May 8 through Sunday, May 10; livestream start time listed as 2:40 p.m. ET / 11:40 a.m. PT (starting Friday, May 8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article gives the overall festival dates and the specific livestream start time to help viewers schedule viewing. It implies viewers should plan around the multi-day schedule.

rubrics_metrics.name: Per-day artist lineup (who performs each day)
rubrics_metrics.description: Daily lineups are provided: Friday (Don Toliver, EsDeeKid, Chief Keef, SahBabii, Xaviersobased, SoFaygo, Luh Tyler, etc.), Saturday (Playboi Carti, Destroy Lonely, Fakemink, Pooh Shiesty, HXG, Nine Vicious, etc.), Sunday (Ken Carson, Sexyy Red, BossMan Dlow, NoCap, OsamaSon, Che, PlaqueBoyMax, Loe Shimmy, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article lists sample performers per day and links to a 'complete Rolling Loud lineup here' for full details — useful for viewers deciding which days/sets to watch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to watch on Prime Video / Amazon Music livestream
rubrics_metrics.description: The livestream is available on Prime Video and via Amazon Music, with an explicit 'Watch on Prime Video' callout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page positions Prime Video as the viewing destination and Amazon Music as the livestream provider; it includes a trailer embed and directs readers to watch on Prime Video starting the stated dates/times.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use trailer/preview before event
rubrics_metrics.description: A trailer for the music festival is provided for readers to watch in advance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article suggests watching the trailer 'in the meantime' — useful for previewing the festival and confirming interest before committing to a trial/subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliate / editorial disclosure about product links
rubrics_metrics.description: All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The disclosure informs readers that product/service links (including those pointing to subscriptions or ticketing) may be affiliate links and that the site may earn commissions — relevant for readers evaluating recommendations or promotional content.
